title: Letter echo trail drop and rise loop
summary: One short uppercase word on a flat saturated field drops from the top edge to the bottom and rises back, letter by letter in a left-to-right wave; each letter drags a stack of fading echoes behind it. Seamless loop.
use_when: A loopable social or banner accent where one word is the whole picture
A high-energy sting between scenes of a longer film
A product name or one-word claim that needs motion without any UI
Square or vertical feeds that autoplay silently

look.type_style: heavy rounded geometric sans, uppercase, wide tracking, one 4-letter word spanning ~92 % of W, cap height ~17 % H

sfx.event: letters fall or rise across the frame with echo trails
each letter settles at the top or bottom edge

structure.shot: one 4-letter word in pale pink across the top edge of a flat red square, crisp, no trail
structure.camera: locked-off: scale 1.00, no pan; only the letters move
structure.motion: hold 15 fr; at 0.50 the first letter starts to sink (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the letters fall to the bottom edge one after another, left first, each dragging fading echoes above it
structure.camera: locked-off: scale 1.00, no pan; only the letters move
structure.motion: per letter travel ~0.75 H, easings.inOutSine ~30 fr (±0.25 s), stagger ~6 fr left to right (±0.25 s); echo trail above each letter, length tracks speed, up to ~0.32 H at peak velocity, fades to the bg

structure.shot: word rests crisp along the bottom edge; the last letter's short trail dies out first
structure.camera: locked-off: scale 1.00, no pan; only the letters move
structure.motion: settle without overshoot (overshoot not measurable); hold ~15 fr fully still

structure.shot: the letters rise back to the top edge in the same left-first wave, echoes now trailing below them
structure.camera: locked-off: scale 1.00, no pan; only the letters move
structure.motion: mirror of the drop: easings.inOutSine ~30 fr per letter (±0.25 s), stagger ~6 fr (±0.25 s), echo trail below, up to ~0.4 H at peak velocity

structure.shot: word back at the top edge, identical to the first frame; last letter's trail fades out
structure.camera: locked-off: scale 1.00, no pan; only the letters move
structure.motion: last letter lands ~4.00 (±0.25 s), then hold ~10 fr; last frame matches frame 0 for the loop

params.brand: any brand.json: bg carries the flat field, accent or fg the letters, display font at heavy weight
params.content.word: one short word, 3-6 letters, uppercase; letters are spread across the frame width
params.aspect: 1:1 (reference) | 4:5 | 9:16 | 16:9; travel = edge to edge on the vertical axis
params.timing.travel: frames per letter for one edge-to-edge move (default 30 at 30 fps)
params.timing.hold: frames each rest holds at an edge (default 15)
params.trail.echoes: number of echo copies behind each letter (default ~12), opacity fading to 0
params.trail.lag: frames of history the trail samples (default ~6); trail length follows speed
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with fps/30

notes: One shot, no cuts, silent. Single technique: per-letter echo trail (closest vocabulary id motion-blur; proposed term echo-trail) driven by a left-to-right letter wave. Measured from 4 fps sheets: travel ~0.75 H per move, adjacent-letter lag ~0.2 s, rests 1.77-2.50 s at the bottom and 3.77-4.33 s at the top; trails are visibly banded (discrete echoes), not a smooth blur, and always sit behind the motion. Trail length scales with speed and is zero at rest. Theme is 'dark' by the luminance rule (bg L ~0.17) although the field reads as saturated red. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed terms: echo-trail, letter-wave.
